verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's pricing page publishes Vitess, Neki, and Postgres cluster pricing that can be queried with SQL, and the billing docs let users view current and previous usage per database. That supports estimating compute costs before committing. Per-unit storage and traffic rates appear only in an old community comment (storage per 10GB, rows read/written), not in current first-party docs. missing for 10: current first-party per-unit storage pricing, any documented traffic/egress pricing, a cost calculator or bill-estimation guidance, and independent confirmation that bills are predictable.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing for compute, storage, and traffic lets me predict my bill before committing

citations.quote: You and your agent can query Vitess, Neki, and Postgres cluster pricing using SQL.
View your current and previous usage per database
$1.25/mo per 10GB storage, $15/mo per 100 Million rows read, $15/mo per 10 Million rows written.
